title: selaginella durvillaei
intro: Selaginella durvillaei, commonly known as "Tall Polypody" or "False Polypody", is a type of evergreen plant belonging to the Selaginellaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella durvillaei include wound healing, pain relief, and antiviral activities, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Research has identified these bioactive compounds as the key to unlocking the plant's medicinal properties, making it a promising candidate for future pharmaceutical applications.
